title: Help Animating AI Photos
author: Professional_Leg6031
selftext:
Looking to animate hentai scenes in my game. Obviously I can't post examples here but hopefully someone can help.

I can make a still frame photo with my character and background. 

I'm looking for something similar to Live2D animation. I don't mind getting my hands somewhat dirty, just trying to make it look nice.

I see a lot of adult AI games doing it and it's the one part of my game I can't get done.  That and NSFW AI pixelart. The service I use has a censor in its policy. 

Any ideas/tips?

replies.author: Professional_Leg6031
replies.body: I can use it. Takes a few minutes, like 15, and it's not always super good at doing exactly what I want it to.

replies.author: very_bad_programmer
replies.body: Yeah, you'll likely have to toss 50 videos for every 1 that comes out exactly how you want it

replies.author: Professional_Leg6031
replies.body: Would you recommend having it run maybe 30 generations overnight when I sleep and I just cross my fingers for it?

replies.author: very_bad_programmer
replies.body:
That's not a bad idea, as long as you've dialed in your prompt. That's another thing to using H3, it takes a while to iterate on prompting until you get a good enough prompt you can run overnight for good results.  Here's a style guide I gave my video gen agent to help it write better video gen prompts. I was finding that my users were sending vague prompts and not getting good results, so it takes their prompts, improves them with these guidelines, and then sends the revised prompt to the H3 workflow. I found that helped a lot:

# How to write the prompt

This labeled structure generally gets the best results. Adapt the content and scale the beats to `duration_seconds`:

1. **Style/look line.** Comma-separated visual descriptors plus mood, e.g. *"2D Sakuga anime style, vivid contrast, dynamic motion blur, impact frames, destructible environment, mood intense, cinematic, explosive"*.
2. `Timeline:` Split into beats whose second-ranges span the **whole** clip (`[0s-1.5s] … [1.5s-3.5s] …`). Each beat names the camera move, the subject's action and the effects.
3. `Camera & Motion:` The overall camera language: whip-pans, tracking shots, slow-mo, high frame-rate fluidity, impact frames.
4. `Audio:` Score or genre, sound effects and timed hits. The model generates **synced** audio, so describe it and name the moments (e.g. *a hit at 7.5s*).
5. `Rules:`
   * Positive constraints: fluid animation, consistent character designs, no static frames.
   * Negatives: no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no blurred low-res artifacts.

**Spoken words.** The model generates real speech and reads the prompt **literally**, so any dialogue, voiceover or narration must be written the way it should sound:

* **Never abbreviate a spoken word:** write "doctor" not "Dr.", "mister" not "Mr.", "missus" not "Mrs.", "professor" not "Prof.", "saint" not "St.", "versus" not "vs.", "et cetera" not "etc." ("Dr." comes out as "durr".)
* **Space out initialisms that are said letter by letter:** "H O A" not "HOA" (which becomes "hoe-uh"), "F B I", "C E O", "D I Y", "U S A". Acronyms that are pronounced as words stay whole: NASA, ASAP, scuba.
* **Spell out numbers, dates, money and symbols** as they're said: "nineteen fifties" not "1950s", "twenty twenty-six" not "2026", "five dollars" not "$5", "ninety percent" not "90%", "and" not "&".
* **Quote the actual spoken line** so it's unambiguous.

The structure is "a strong default, not a straitjacket": keep the prompt vivid, drop sections that don't fit a simpler request, and match the number of beats to the clip length.

replies.author: Professional_Leg6031
replies.body: Woah! Very helpful, thanks a bunch.

replies.author: very_bad_programmer
replies.body: You bet, good luck on your project!

comments.author: Financial_Employ1946
comments.body:
Most adult AI games aren't rigging Live2D, they loop short image-to-video clips. I lost a week slicing layers off AI stills. Animate your still through Mage Space with mature mode on.  

  
Then ping pong loop the clip in engine so the seam never shows
